items.title: FFIV Q3 deep dive: AI-driven demand and security focus shape outlook amid margin pressures
items.summary: Application security provider F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with sales up 13.3% year on year to $917.4 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $885 million at the midpoint, 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.42 per share was 3.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
